mapper.select: SELECT sb.settle_id AS settleId, sb.round_no AS roundNo, sb.type AS type, sb.status AS status, sb.total_amount AS totalAmount, sb.planned_amount AS plannedAmount, sb.planned_tax_amount AS plannedTaxAmount, sb.planned_date AS plannedDate, sb.trader_name AS traderName, sb.bank_name AS bankName, sb.account_number AS accountNumber, sb.account_holder AS accountHolder, sb.actual_amount AS actualAmount, sb.actual_date AS actualDate, sb.created_at AS createdAt, agg.actual_amount_sum AS actualAmountSum FROM settlement_block sb JOIN block b ON b.block_id = sb.block_id JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT st2.project_id AS project_id, sb2.type AS type, SUM(sb2.actual_amount) AS actual_amount_sum FROM settlement_block sb2 JOIN block b2 ON b2.block_id = sb2.block_id JOIN step st2 ON st2.step_id = b2.step_id WHERE sb2.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY st2.project_id, sb2.type ) agg ON agg.project_id = st.project_id AND agg.type = sb.type WHERE sb.settle_id IN #{id} AND sb.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT sb2.total_amount FROM settlement_block sb2 JOIN block b2 ON b2.block_id = sb2.block_id JOIN step st2 ON st2.step_id = b2.step_id WHERE st2.project_id = ( SELECT st.project_id FROM settlement_block sb JOIN block b ON b.block_id = sb.block_id JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id WHERE sb.settle_id = #{settleId} ) AND sb2.type = #{type} AND sb2.settle_id != #{settleId} AND sb2.total_amount IS NOT NULL AND sb2.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY (sb2.status != 'PENDING') DESC, sb2.settle_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM settlement_block sbc JOIN block bc ON bc.block_id = sbc.block_id JOIN step stc ON stc.step_id = bc.step_id WHERE stc.project_id = target.project_id AND sbc.type = #{type} AND sbc.settle_id != #{settleId} AND sbc.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS blockCount, (SELECT sbt.total_amount FROM settlement_block sbt JOIN block bt ON bt.block_id = sbt.block_id JOIN step stt ON stt.step_id = bt.step_id WHERE stt.project_id = target.project_id AND sbt.type = #{type} AND sbt.settle_id != #{settleId} AND sbt.total_amount IS NOT NULL AND sbt.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY (sbt.status != 'PENDING') DESC, sbt.settle_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS recommendedTotalAmount FROM ( SELECT st0.project_id AS project_id FROM settlement_block sb0 JOIN block b0 ON b0.block_id = sb0.block_id JOIN step st0 ON st0.step_id = b0.step_id WHERE sb0.settle_id = #{settleId} ) target
